product.title: San Diego Whale Watching Cruise (3-Hour Coastal Wildlife Tour)
product.description: This 3-hour whale watching cruise from San Diego takes you along the local coastline to look for marine wildlife and broad Pacific views. Conditions vary by season, but sightings can include whales, dolphins, seabirds, and other coastal species while you cruise offshore waters with city and shoreline scenery in the background. Onboard naturalist or captain commentary shares context on migration patterns, behavior, and local marine habitats when available. The format is straightforward and family-friendly, making it a strong fit for couples, groups, and visitors seeking a classic San Diego ocean activity.
highlights: 3-hour whale watching cruise from San Diego.
Look for whales, dolphins, and other marine wildlife.
Enjoy coastal views and open-ocean scenery from the water.
